property_summary: For any non-zero newOwner, the owner's call to transferOwnership(newOwner) must succeed and c.owner() must equal newOwner; the mutant reverts for every non-zero newOwner (accepting only the zero address), breaking the rule.
change_summary: Invert the zero-address check to `newOwner == address(0)` so transfers to real addresses revert and only renouncing-style zero transfers succeed.
